23028008	The prophets of old who preceded you and me prophesied war, disaster, and plague against many lands and great kingdoms.
23028009	As for the prophet who prophesies peace, only if the word of the prophet comes true will the prophet be recognized as one the LORD has truly sent.”
23028010	Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke it.
23028011	And in the presence of all the people Hananiah proclaimed, “This is what the LORD says: ‘In this way, within two years I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon off the neck of all the nations.’” At this, Jeremiah the prophet went on his way.
23028012	But shortly after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke off his neck, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
23028013	“Go and tell Hananiah that this is what the LORD says: ‘You have broken a yoke of wood, but in its place you have fashioned a yoke of iron.’
23028014	For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him. I have even given him control of the beasts of the field.’”
23028015	Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah, “Listen, Hananiah! The LORD did not send you, but you have persuaded this people to trust in a lie.
23028016	Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to remove you from the face of the earth. You will die this year because you have preached rebellion against the LORD.’”
23028017	And in the seventh month of that very year, the prophet Hananiah died.
23029001	This is the text of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders among the exiles and to the priests, the prophets, and all the others Nebuchadnezzar had carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
23029002	(This was after King Jeconiah, the queen mother, the court officials, the officials of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the metalsmiths had been exiled from Jerusalem.)
23029003	The letter was entrusted to Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It stated:
23029004	This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles who were carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon:
23029005	“Build houses and settle down. Plant gardens and eat their produce.
23029006	Take wives and have sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Multiply there; do not decrease.
23029007	Seek the prosperity of the city to which I have sent you as exiles. Pray to the LORD on its behalf, for if it prospers, you too will prosper.”
23029008	For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Do not be deceived by the prophets and diviners among you, and do not listen to the dreams you elicit from them.
23029009	For they are falsely prophesying to you in My name; I have not sent them, declares the LORD.”
23029010	For this is what the LORD says: “When Babylon’s seventy years are complete, I will attend to you and confirm My promise to restore you to this place.
23029011	For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.
23029012	Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
23029013	You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
23029014	I will be found by you, declares the LORD, and I will restore you from captivity and gather you from all the nations and places to which I have banished you, declares the LORD. I will restore you to the place from which I sent you into exile.”
23029015	Because you may say, “The LORD has raised up for us prophets in Babylon,”
23029016	this is what the LORD says about the king who sits on David’s throne and all the people who remain in this city, your brothers who did not go with you into exile—
23029017	this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will send against them sword and famine and plague, and I will make them like rotten figs, so bad they cannot be eaten.
23029018	I will pursue them with sword and famine and plague. I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth—a curse, a desolation, and an object of scorn and reproach among all the nations to which I banish them.
23029019	I will do this because they have not listened to My words, declares the LORD, which I sent to them again and again through My servants the prophets. And neither have you exiles listened, declares the LORD.”
23029020	So hear the word of the LORD, all you exiles I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
23029021	This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying to you lies in My name: “I will deliver them to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will kill them before your very eyes.
23029022	Because of them, all the exiles of Judah who are in Babylon will use this curse: ‘May the LORD make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire!’
23029023	For they have committed an outrage in Israel by committing adultery with the wives of their neighbors and speaking lies in My name, which I did not command them to do. I am He who knows, and I am a witness, declares the LORD.”
23029024	You are to tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite that
23029025	this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “In your own name you have sent out letters to all the people of Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and to all the priests. You said to Zephaniah:
23029026	‘The LORD has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada, to be the chief officer in the house of the LORD, responsible for any madman who acts like a prophet—you must put him in stocks and neck irons.
23029027	So now, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who poses as a prophet among you?
23029028	For he has sent to us in Babylon, claiming: Since the exile will be lengthy, build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat their produce.’”
23029029	(Zephaniah the priest, however, had read this letter to Jeremiah the prophet.)
23029030	Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
23029031	“Send a message telling all the exiles what the LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite. Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you—though I did not send him—and has made you trust in a lie,
23029032	this is what the LORD says: ‘I will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants. He will have no one left among this people, nor will he see the good that I will bring to My people, declares the LORD, for he has preached rebellion against the LORD.’”
23030001	This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
23030002	“This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Write in a book all the words that I have spoken to you.
23030003	For behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will restore from captivity My people Israel and Judah, declares the LORD. I will restore them to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.’”
23030004	These are the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and Judah.
23030005	Yes, this is what the LORD says: “A cry of panic is heard— a cry of terror, not of peace.
23030006	Ask now, and see: Can a male give birth? Why then do I see every man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor and every face turned pale?
23030007	How awful that day will be! None will be like it! It is the time of Jacob’s distress, but he will be saved out of it.
23030008	On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will break the yoke off their necks and tear off their bonds, and no longer will strangers enslave them.
23030009	Instead, they will serve the LORD their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.
23030010	As for you, O Jacob My servant, do not be afraid, declares the LORD, and do not be dismayed, O Israel. For I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their captivity! Jacob will return to quiet and ease, with no one to make him afraid.
23030011	For I am with you to save you, declares the LORD. Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have scattered you, I will not completely destroy you. Yet I will discipline you justly, and will by no means leave you unpunished.”
23030012	For this is what the LORD says: “Your injury is incurable; your wound is grievous.
23030013	There is no one to plead your cause, no remedy for your sores, no recovery for you.
23030014	All your lovers have forgotten you; they no longer seek you, for I have struck you as an enemy would, with the discipline of someone cruel, because of your great iniquity and your numerous sins.
23030015	Why do you cry out over your wound? Your pain has no cure! Because of your great iniquity and your numerous sins I have done these things to you.
23030016	Nevertheless, all who devour you will be devoured, and all your adversaries—every one of them— will go off into exile. Those who plundered you will be plundered, and all who raided you will be raided.
23030017	But I will restore your health and heal your wounds, declares the LORD, because they call you an outcast, Zion, for whom no one cares.”
23030018	This is what the LORD says: “I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings. And the city will be rebuilt on her own ruins, and the palace will stand in its rightful place.
23030019	Thanksgiving will proceed from them, a sound of celebration. I will multiply them, and they will not be decreased; I will honor them, and they will not be belittled.
23030020	Their children will be as in days of old, and their congregation will be established before Me; and I will punish all their oppressors.
23030021	Their leader will be one of their own, and their ruler will arise from their midst. And I will bring him near, and he will approach Me, for who would dare on his own to approach Me?” declares the LORD.
23030022	“And you will be My people, and I will be your God.”
23030023	Behold, the storm of the LORD has gone out with fury, a whirlwind swirling down upon the heads of the wicked.
23030024	The fierce anger of the LORD will not turn back until He has fully accomplished the purposes of His heart. In the days to come you will understand this.
23031001	“At that time,” declares the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be My people.”
23031002	This is what the LORD says: “The people who survived the sword found favor in the wilderness when Israel went to find rest.”
23031003	The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying: “I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with loving devotion.
23031004	Again I will build you, and you will be rebuilt, O Virgin Israel. Again you will take up your tambourines and go out in joyful dancing.
23031005	Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the farmers will plant and enjoy the fruit.
23031006	For there will be a day when watchmen will call out on the hills of Ephraim, ‘Arise, let us go up to Zion, to the LORD our God!’”
23031007	For this is what the LORD says: “Sing with joy for Jacob; shout for the foremost of the nations! Make your praises heard, and say, ‘O LORD, save Your people, the remnant of Israel!’
23031008	Behold, I will bring them from the land of the north and gather them from the farthest parts of the earth, including the blind and the lame, expectant mothers and women in labor. They will return as a great assembly!
23031009	They will come with weeping, and by their supplication I will lead them; I will make them walk beside streams of waters, on a level path where they will not stumble. For I am Israel’s Father, and Ephraim is My firstborn.”
23031010	Hear, O nations, the word of the LORD, and proclaim it in distant coastlands: “The One who scattered Israel will gather them and keep them as a shepherd keeps his flock.
23031011	For the LORD has ransomed Jacob and redeemed him from the hand that had overpowered him.
23031012	They will come and shout for joy on the heights of Zion; they will be radiant over the bounty of the LORD— the grain, new wine, and oil, and the young of the flocks and herds. Their life will be like a well-watered garden, and never again will they languish.
23031013	Then the maidens will rejoice with dancing, young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into joy, and give them comfort and joy for their sorrow.
23031014	I will fill the souls of the priests abundantly, and will fill My people with My goodness,” declares the LORD.
23031015	This is what the LORD says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”
23031016	This is what the LORD says: “Keep your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears, for the reward for your work will come, declares the LORD. Then your children will return from the land of the enemy.
23031017	So there is hope for your future, declares the LORD, and your children will return to their own land.
23031018	I have surely heard Ephraim’s moaning: ‘You disciplined me severely, like an untrained calf. Restore me, that I may return, for You are the LORD my God.
23031019	After I returned, I repented; and after I was instructed, I struck my thigh in grief. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’
23031020	Is not Ephraim a precious son to Me, a delightful child? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore My heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him,” declares the LORD.
23031021	“Set up the road markers, put up the signposts. Keep the highway in mind, the road you have traveled. Return, O Virgin Israel, return to these cities of yours.
23031022	How long will you wander, O faithless daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the land— a woman will shelter a man.”
23031023	This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “When I restore them from captivity, they will once again speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities: ‘May the LORD bless you, O righteous dwelling place, O holy mountain.’
23031024	And Judah and all its cities will dwell together in the land, the farmers and those who move with the flocks,
23031025	for I will refresh the weary soul and replenish all who are weak.”
23031026	At this I awoke and looked around. My sleep had been most pleasant to me.
23031027	“The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and of beast.
23031028	Just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, to demolish, destroy, and bring disaster, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” declares the LORD.
23031029	“In those days, it will no longer be said: ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are set on edge.’
23031030	Instead, each will die for his own iniquity. If anyone eats the sour grapes, his own teeth will be set on edge.
23031031	Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.
23031032	It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt— a covenant they broke, though I was a husband to them,” declares the LORD.
23031033	“But this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the LORD. I will put My law in their minds and inscribe it on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
23031034	No longer will each man teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest, declares the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”
23031035	Thus says the LORD, who gives the sun for light by day, who sets in order the moon and stars for light by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar—the LORD of Hosts is His name:
23031036	“Only if this fixed order departed from My presence, declares the LORD, would Israel’s descendants ever cease to be a nation before Me.”
23031037	This is what the LORD says: “Only if the heavens above could be measured and the foundations of the earth below searched out would I reject all of Israel’s descendants because of all they have done,” declares the LORD.
23031038	“The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when this city will be rebuilt for Me, from the tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
23031039	The measuring line will once again stretch out straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn toward Goah.
23031040	The whole valley of the dead bodies and ashes, and all the fields as far as the Kidron Valley, to the corner of the Horse Gate to the east, will be holy to the LORD. It will never again be uprooted or demolished.”
23032001	This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
23032002	At that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard, which was in the palace of the king of Judah.
23032003	For Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him, saying: “Why are you prophesying like this? You claim that the LORD says, ‘Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
23032004	Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hands of the Chaldeans, but he will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye.
23032005	He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will stay until I attend to him, declares the LORD. If you fight against the Chaldeans, you will not succeed.’”
23032006	Jeremiah replied, “The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
23032007	Behold! Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, is coming to you to say, ‘Buy for yourself my field in Anathoth, for you have the right of redemption to buy it.’
23032008	Then, as the LORD had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and urged me, ‘Please buy my field in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin, for you own the right of inheritance and redemption. Buy it for yourself.’” Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
23032009	So I bought the field in Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel, and I weighed out seventeen shekels of silver.
23032010	I signed and sealed the deed, called in witnesses, and weighed out the silver on the scales.
23032011	Then I took the deed of purchase—the sealed copy with its terms and conditions, as well as the open copy—
23032012	and I gave this deed to Baruch son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the sight of my cousin Hanamel and the witnesses who were signing the purchase agreement and all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
23032013	In their sight I instructed Baruch,
23032014	“This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Take these deeds—both the sealed copy and the open copy of the deed of purchase—and put them in a clay jar to preserve them for a long time.
23032015	For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields, and vineyards will again be bought in this land.”
23032016	After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD:
23032017	“Oh, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for You!
23032018	You show loving devotion to thousands but lay the iniquity of the fathers into the laps of their children after them, O great and mighty God whose name is the LORD of Hosts,
23032019	the One great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are on all the ways of the sons of men, to reward each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds.
23032020	You performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, and You do so to this very day, both in Israel and among all mankind. And You have made a name for Yourself, as is the case to this day.
23032021	You brought Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror.
23032022	You gave them this land that You had sworn to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.
23032023	They came in and possessed it, but they did not obey Your voice or walk in Your law. They failed to perform all that You commanded them to do, and so You have brought upon them all this disaster.
23032024	See how the siege ramps are mounted against the city to capture it. And by sword and famine and plague, the city has been given into the hands of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it. What You have spoken has happened, as You now see!
23032025	Yet You, O Lord GOD, have said to me, ‘Buy for yourself the field with silver and call in witnesses, even though the city has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans!’”
23032026	Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
23032027	“Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is anything too difficult for Me?
23032028	Therefore this is what the LORD says: Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hands of the Chaldeans and of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.
23032029	And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will come in, set it on fire, and burn it, along with the houses of those who provoked Me to anger by burning incense to Baal on their rooftops and by pouring out drink offerings to other gods.
23032030	For the children of Israel and of Judah have done nothing but evil in My sight from their youth; indeed, they have done nothing but provoke Me to anger by the work of their hands, declares the LORD.
23032031	For this city has aroused My wrath and fury from the day it was built until now. Therefore I will remove it from My presence
23032032	because of all the evil the children of Israel and of Judah have done to provoke Me to anger—they, their kings, their officials, their priests and prophets, the men of Judah, and the residents of Jerusalem.
23032033	They have turned their backs to Me and not their faces. Though I taught them again and again, they would not listen or respond to discipline.
23032034	They have placed their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.
23032035	They have built the high places of Baal in the Valley of Ben-hinnom to make their sons and daughters pass through the fire to Molech—something I never commanded them, nor had it ever entered My mind, that they should commit such an abomination and cause Judah to sin.
23032036	Now therefore, about this city of which you say, ‘It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by sword and famine and plague,’ this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says:
23032037	I will surely gather My people from all the lands to which I have banished them in My furious anger and great wrath, and I will return them to this place and make them dwell in safety.
23032038	They will be My people, and I will be their God.
23032039	I will give them one heart and one way, so that they will always fear Me for their own good and for the good of their children after them.
23032040	I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never turn away from doing good to them, and I will put My fear in their hearts, so that they will never turn away from Me.
23032041	Yes, I will rejoice in doing them good, and I will faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and with all My soul.
23032042	For this is what the LORD says: Just as I have brought all this great disaster on this people, so I will bring on them all the good I have promised them.
23032043	And fields will be bought in this land about which you are saying, ‘It is a desolation, without man or beast; it has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans.’
23032044	Fields will be purchased with silver, and deeds will be signed, sealed, and witnessed in the land of Benjamin, in the areas surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah—the cities of the hill country, the foothills, and the Negev—because I will restore them from captivity, declares the LORD.”
23033001	While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD came to him a second time:
23033002	“Thus says the LORD who made the earth, the LORD who formed it and established it, the LORD is His name:
23033003	Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
23033004	For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says about the houses of this city and the palaces of the kings of Judah that have been torn down for defense against the siege ramps and the sword:
23033005	The Chaldeans are coming to fight and to fill those places with the corpses of the men I will strike down in My anger and in My wrath. I have hidden My face from this city because of all its wickedness.
23033006	Nevertheless, I will bring to it health and healing, and I will heal its people and reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth.
23033007	I will restore Judah and Israel from captivity and will rebuild them as in former times.
23033008	And I will cleanse them from all the iniquity they have committed against Me, and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against Me.
23033009	So this city will bring Me renown, joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear of all the good I do for it. They will tremble in awe because of all the goodness and prosperity that I will provide for it.
23033010	This is what the LORD says: In this place you say is a wasteland without man or beast, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted—inhabited by neither man nor beast—there will be heard again
23033011	the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those bringing thank offerings into the house of the LORD, saying: ‘Give thanks to the LORD of Hosts, for the LORD is good; His loving devotion endures forever.’ For I will restore the land from captivity as in former times, says the LORD.
23033012	This is what the LORD of Hosts says: In this desolate place, without man or beast, and in all its cities, there will once more be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks.
23033013	In the cities of the hill country, the foothills, and the Negev, in the land of Benjamin and the cities surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of the one who counts them, says the LORD.
23033014	Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will fulfill the gracious promise that I have spoken to the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
23033015	In those days and at that time I will cause to sprout for David a righteous Branch, and He will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
23033016	In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell securely, and this is the name by which it will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.
23033017	For this is what the LORD says: David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel,
23033018	nor will the priests who are Levites ever fail to have a man before Me to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings, and to present sacrifices.”
23033019	And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
23033020	“This is what the LORD says: If you can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, so that day and night cease to occupy their appointed time,
23033021	then My covenant may also be broken with David My servant and with My ministers the Levites who are priests, so that David will not have a son to reign on his throne.
23033022	As the hosts of heaven cannot be counted and as the sand on the seashore cannot be measured, so too will I multiply the descendants of My servant David and the Levites who minister before Me.”
23033023	Moreover, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
23033024	“Have you not noticed what these people are saying: ‘The LORD has rejected the two families He had chosen’? So they despise My people and no longer regard them as a nation.
23033025	This is what the LORD says: If I have not established My covenant with the day and the night and the fixed order of heaven and earth,
23033026	then I would also reject the descendants of Jacob and of My servant David, so as not to take from his descendants rulers over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will restore them from captivity and will have compassion on them.”
23034001	This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, all his army, all the earthly kingdoms under his control, and all the other nations were fighting against Jerusalem and all its surrounding cities.
23034002	The LORD, the God of Israel, told Jeremiah to go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him that this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.
23034003	And you yourself will not escape his grasp, but will surely be captured and delivered into his hand. You will see the king of Babylon eye to eye and speak with him face to face; and you will go to Babylon.
23034004	Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah. This is what the LORD says concerning you: You will not die by the sword;
23034005	you will die in peace. As spices were burned for your fathers, the former kings who preceded you, so people will burn spices for you and lament, ‘Alas, O master!’ For I Myself have spoken this word, declares the LORD.”
23034006	In Jerusalem, then, Jeremiah the prophet relayed all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah
23034007	as the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and the remaining cities of Judah—against Lachish and Azekah. For these were the only fortified cities remaining in Judah.
23034008	After King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to proclaim liberty, the word came to Jeremiah from the LORD
23034009	that each man should free his Hebrew slaves, both male and female, and no one should hold his fellow Jew in bondage.
23034010	So all the officials and all the people who entered into this covenant agreed that they would free their menservants and maidservants and no longer hold them in bondage. They obeyed and released them,
23034011	but later they changed their minds and took back the menservants and maidservants they had freed, and they forced them to become slaves again.
23034012	Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
23034013	“This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your forefathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying:
23034014	Every seventh year, each of you must free his Hebrew brother who has sold himself to you. He may serve you six years, but then you must let him go free. But your fathers did not listen or incline their ear.
23034015	Recently you repented and did what pleased Me; each of you proclaimed freedom for his neighbor. You made a covenant before Me in the house that bears My Name.
23034016	But now you have changed your minds and profaned My name. Each of you has taken back the menservants and maidservants whom you had set at liberty to go wherever they wanted, and you have again forced them to be your slaves.
23034017	Therefore this is what the LORD says: You have not obeyed Me; you have not proclaimed freedom, each man for his brother and for his neighbor. So now I proclaim freedom for you, declares the LORD—freedom to fall by sword, by plague, and by famine! I will make you a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
23034018	And those who have transgressed My covenant and have not fulfilled the terms of the covenant they made before Me, I will treat like the calf they cut in two in order to pass between its pieces.
23034019	The officials of Judah and Jerusalem, the court officials, the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the pieces of the calf,
23034020	I will deliver into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives. Their corpses will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.
23034021	And I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives, to the army of the king of Babylon that had withdrawn from you.
23034022	Behold, I am going to give the command, declares the LORD, and I will bring them back to this city. They will fight against it, capture it, and burn it down. And I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”
23035001	This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:
23035002	“Go to the house of the Rechabites, speak to them, and bring them to one of the chambers of the house of the LORD to offer them a drink of wine.”
23035003	So I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the entire house of the Rechabites—
23035004	and I brought them into the house of the LORD, to a chamber occupied by the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God. This room was near the chamber of the officials, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.
23035005	Then I set pitchers full of wine and some cups before the men of the house of the Rechabites, and I said to them, “Drink some wine.”
23035006	“We do not drink wine,” they replied, “for our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab commanded us, ‘Neither you nor your descendants are ever to drink wine.
23035007	Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard. Those things are not for you. Instead, you must live in tents all your lives, so that you may live a long time in the land where you wander.’
23035008	And we have obeyed the voice of our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab in all he commanded us. So we have not drunk wine all our lives—neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters.
23035009	Nor have we built houses in which to live, and we have not owned any vineyards or fields or crops.
23035010	But we have lived in tents and have obeyed and done exactly as our forefather Jonadab commanded us.
23035011	So when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land, we said: ‘Come, let us go into Jerusalem to escape the armies of the Chaldeans and the Arameans.’ So we have remained in Jerusalem.”
23035012	Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
23035013	“This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem: ‘Will you not accept discipline and obey My words?’ declares the LORD.
23035014	The words of Jonadab son of Rechab have been carried out. He commanded his sons not to drink wine, and they have not drunk it to this very day because they have obeyed the command of their forefather. But I have spoken to you again and again, and you have not obeyed Me!
23035015	Again and again I have sent you all My servants the prophets, proclaiming: ‘Turn now, each of you, from your wicked ways, and correct your actions. Do not go after other gods to serve them. Live in the land that I have given to you and your fathers.’ But you have not inclined your ear or listened to Me.
23035016	Yes, the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not listened to Me.
23035017	Therefore this is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring to Judah and to all the residents of Jerusalem all the disaster I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them but they have not obeyed, and I have called to them but they have not answered.’”
23035018	Then Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the command of your forefather Jonadab and have kept all his commandments and have done all that he charged you to do,
23035019	this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Jonadab son of Rechab will never fail to have a man to stand before Me.’”
23036001	In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
23036002	“Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah, and all the nations, from the day I first spoke to you during the reign of Josiah until today.
23036003	Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about all the calamity I plan to bring upon them, each of them will turn from his wicked way. Then I will forgive their iniquity and their sin.”
23036004	So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and at the dictation of Jeremiah, Baruch wrote on a scroll all the words that the LORD had spoken to Jeremiah.
23036005	Then Jeremiah commanded Baruch, “I am restricted; I cannot enter the house of the LORD;
23036006	so you are to go to the house of the LORD on a day of fasting, and in the hearing of the people you are to read the words of the LORD from the scroll you have written at my dictation. Read them in the hearing of all the people of Judah who are coming from their cities.
23036007	Perhaps they will bring their petition before the LORD, and each one will turn from his wicked way; for great are the anger and fury that the LORD has pronounced against this people.”
23036008	So Baruch son of Neriah did everything that Jeremiah the prophet had commanded him. In the house of the LORD he read the words of the LORD from the scroll.
23036009	Now in the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, a fast before the LORD was proclaimed to all the people of Jerusalem and all who had come there from the cities of Judah.
23036010	From the chamber of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, which was in the upper courtyard at the opening of the New Gate of the house of the LORD, Baruch read from the scroll the words of Jeremiah in the hearing of all the people.
23036011	When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD from the scroll,
23036012	he went down to the scribe’s chamber in the king’s palace, where all the officials were sitting: Elishama the scribe, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Achbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.
23036013	And Micaiah reported to them all the words he had heard Baruch read from the scroll in the hearing of the people.
23036014	Then all the officials sent word to Baruch through Jehudi son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, saying, “Bring the scroll that you read in the hearing of the people, and come here.” So Baruch son of Neriah took the scroll and went to them.
23036015	“Please sit down,” they said, “and read it in our hearing.” So Baruch read it in their hearing.
23036016	When they had heard all these words, they turned to one another in fear and said to Baruch, “Surely we must report all these words to the king.”
23036017	“Tell us now,” they asked Baruch, “how did you write all these words? Was it at Jeremiah’s dictation?”
23036018	“It was at his dictation,” Baruch replied. “He recited all these words to me and I wrote them in ink on the scroll.”
23036019	Then the officials said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah must hide yourselves and tell no one where you are.”
23036020	So the officials went to the king in the courtyard. And having stored the scroll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, they reported everything to the king.
23036021	Then the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it from the chamber of Elishama the scribe. And Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king and all the officials who were standing beside him.
23036022	Since it was the ninth month, the king was sitting in his winter quarters with a fire burning before him.
23036023	And as soon as Jehudi had read three or four columns, Jehoiakim would cut them off with a scribe’s knife and throw them into the firepot, until the entire scroll had been consumed by the fire.
23036024	Yet in hearing all these words, the king and his servants did not become frightened or tear their garments.
23036025	Even though Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.
23036026	Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel, a son of the king, as well as Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel, to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the LORD had hidden them.
23036027	After the king had burned the scroll containing the words that Baruch had written at Jeremiah’s dictation, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
23036028	“Take another scroll and rewrite on it the very words that were on the original scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah has burned.
23036029	You are to proclaim concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah that this is what the LORD says: You have burned the scroll and said, ‘Why have you written on it that the king of Babylon would surely come and destroy this land and deprive it of man and beast?’
23036030	Therefore this is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one to sit on David’s throne, and his body will be thrown out and exposed to heat by day and frost by night.
23036031	I will punish him and his descendants and servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the residents of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the calamity about which I warned them but they did not listen.”
23036032	Then Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch son of Neriah, and at Jeremiah’s dictation he wrote on it all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And many similar words were added to them.
23037001	Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made Zedekiah son of Josiah the king of Judah, and he reigned in place of Coniah son of Jehoiakim.
23037002	But he and his officers and the people of the land refused to obey the words that the LORD had spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.
23037003	Yet King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the priest, the son of Maaseiah, to Jeremiah the prophet with the message, “Please pray to the LORD our God for us!”
23037004	Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people, for they had not yet put him in prison.
23037005	Pharaoh’s army had left Egypt, and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard the report, they withdrew from Jerusalem.
23037006	Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet:
23037007	“This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says that you are to tell the king of Judah, who sent you to Me: Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has marched out to help you, will go back to its own land of Egypt.
23037008	Then the Chaldeans will return and fight against this city. They will capture it and burn it down.
23037009	This is what the LORD says: Do not deceive yourselves by saying, ‘The Chaldeans will go away for good,’ for they will not!
23037010	Indeed, if you were to strike down the entire army of the Chaldeans that is fighting against you, and only wounded men remained in their tents, they would still get up and burn this city down.”
23037011	When the Chaldean army withdrew from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,
23037012	Jeremiah started to leave Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin to claim his portion there among the people.
23037013	But when he reached the Gate of Benjamin, the captain of the guard, whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah, seized him and said, “You are deserting to the Chaldeans!”
23037014	“That is a lie,” Jeremiah replied. “I am not deserting to the Chaldeans!” But Irijah would not listen to him; instead, he arrested Jeremiah and took him to the officials.
23037015	The officials were angry with Jeremiah, and they beat him and placed him in jail in the house of Jonathan the scribe, for it had been made into a prison.
23037016	So Jeremiah went into a cell in the dungeon and remained there a long time.
23037017	Later, King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah and received him in his palace, where he asked him privately, “Is there a word from the LORD?” “There is,” Jeremiah replied. “You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.”
23037018	Then Jeremiah asked King Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you or your servants or these people, that you have put me in prison?
23037019	Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, claiming, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you or this land’?
23037020	But now please listen, O my lord the king. May my petition come before you. Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe, or I will die there.”
23037021	So King Zedekiah gave orders for Jeremiah to be placed in the courtyard of the guard and given a loaf of bread daily from the street of the bakers, until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.
23038001	Now Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, Jucal son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur son of Malchijah heard that Jeremiah had been telling all the people:
23038002	“This is what the LORD says: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine and plague, but whoever surrenders to the Chaldeans will live; he will retain his life like a spoil of war, and he will live.
23038003	This is what the LORD says: This city will surely be delivered into the hands of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.”
23038004	Then the officials said to the king, “This man ought to die, for he is discouraging the warriors who remain in this city, as well as all the people, by speaking such words to them; this man is not seeking the well-being of these people, but their ruin.”
23038005	“Here he is,” replied King Zedekiah. “He is in your hands, since the king can do nothing to stop you.”
23038006	So they took Jeremiah and dropped him into the cistern of Malchiah, the king’s son, which was in the courtyard of the guard. They lowered Jeremiah with ropes into the cistern, which had no water but only mud, and Jeremiah sank down into the mud.
23038007	Now Ebed-melech the Cushite, a court official in the royal palace, heard that Jeremiah had been put into the cistern. While the king was sitting at the Gate of Benjamin,
23038008	Ebed-melech went out from the king’s palace and said to the king,
23038009	“My lord the king, these men have acted wickedly in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet. They have dropped him into the cistern, where he will starve to death, for there is no more bread in the city.”
23038010	So the king commanded Ebed-melech the Cushite, “Take thirty men from here with you and pull Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies.”
23038011	Then Ebed-melech took the men with him and went to the king’s palace, to a place below the storehouse. From there he took old rags and worn-out clothes and lowered them with ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern.
23038012	Ebed-melech the Cushite cried out to Jeremiah, “Put these worn-out rags and clothes under your arms to pad the ropes.” Jeremiah did so,
23038013	and they pulled him up with the ropes and lifted him out of the cistern. And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.
23038014	Then King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah the prophet and received him at the third entrance to the house of the LORD. “I am going to ask you something,” said the king to Jeremiah. “Do not hide anything from me.”
23038015	“If I tell you,” Jeremiah replied, “you will surely put me to death. And even if I give you advice, you will not listen to me.”
23038016	But King Zedekiah swore secretly to Jeremiah, “As surely as the LORD lives, who has given us this life, I will not kill you, nor will I deliver you into the hands of these men who are seeking your life.”
23038017	Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “This is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you indeed surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, then you will live, this city will not be burned down, and you and your household will survive.
23038018	But if you do not surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, then this city will be delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans. They will burn it down, and you yourself will not escape their grasp.’”
23038019	But King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have deserted to the Chaldeans, for the Chaldeans may deliver me into their hands to abuse me.”
23038020	“They will not hand you over,” Jeremiah replied. “Obey the voice of the LORD in what I am telling you, that it may go well with you and you may live.
23038021	But if you refuse to surrender, this is the word that the LORD has shown me:
23038022	All the women who remain in the palace of the king of Judah will be brought out to the officials of the king of Babylon, and those women will say: ‘They misled you and overcame you— those trusted friends of yours. Your feet sank into the mire, and they deserted you.’
23038023	All your wives and children will be brought out to the Chaldeans. And you yourself will not escape their grasp, for you will be seized by the king of Babylon, and this city will be burned down.”
23038024	Then Zedekiah warned Jeremiah, “Do not let anyone know about this conversation, or you will die.
23038025	If the officials hear that I have spoken with you, and they come and demand of you, ‘Tell us what you said to the king and what he said to you; do not hide it from us, or we will kill you,’
23038026	then tell them, ‘I was presenting to the king my petition that he not return me to the house of Jonathan to die there.’”
23038027	When all the officials came to Jeremiah and questioned him, he relayed to them the exact words the king had commanded him to say. So they said no more to him, for no one had overheard the conversation.
23038028	And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard until the day Jerusalem was captured.
23039001	In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his entire army and laid siege to the city.
23039002	And on the ninth day of the fourth month of Zedekiah’s eleventh year, the city was breached.
23039003	Then all the officials of the king of Babylon entered and sat in the Middle Gate: Nergal-sharezer of Samgar, Nebo-sarsekim the Rabsaris, Nergal-sharezer the Rabmag, and all the rest of the officials of the king of Babylon.
23039004	When Zedekiah king of Judah and all the soldiers saw them, they fled. They left the city at night by way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls, and they went out along the route to the Arabah.
23039005	But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. They seized him and brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced judgment on him.
23039006	There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and he also killed all the nobles of Judah.
23039007	Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him with bronze chains to take him to Babylon.
23039008	The Chaldeans set fire to the palace of the king and to the houses of the people, and they broke down the walls of Jerusalem.
23039009	Then Nebuzaradan captain of the guard carried away to Babylon the remnant of the people who had remained in the city, along with the deserters who had defected to him.
23039010	But Nebuzaradan left behind in the land of Judah some of the poor people who had no property, and at that time he gave them vineyards and fields.
23039011	Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had given orders about Jeremiah through Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, saying,
23039012	“Take him, look after him, and do not let any harm come to him; do for him whatever he says.”
23039013	So Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, Nebushazban the Rabsaris, Nergal-sharezer the Rabmag, and all the captains of the king of Babylon
23039014	had Jeremiah brought from the courtyard of the guard, and they turned him over to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to take him home. So Jeremiah remained among his own people.
23039015	And while Jeremiah had been confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD had come to him:
23039016	“Go and tell Ebed-melech the Cushite that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I am about to fulfill My words against this city for harm and not for good, and on that day they will be fulfilled before your eyes.
23039017	But I will deliver you on that day, declares the LORD, and you will not be delivered into the hands of the men whom you fear.
23039018	For I will surely rescue you so that you do not fall by the sword. Because you have trusted in Me, you will escape with your life like a spoil of war, declares the LORD.’”
23040001	This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD after Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had released him at Ramah, having found him bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were being exiled to Babylon.
23040002	The captain of the guard found Jeremiah and said to him, “The LORD your God decreed this disaster on this place,
23040003	and now the LORD has fulfilled it; He has done just as He said. Because you people have sinned against the LORD and have not obeyed His voice, this thing has happened to you.
23040004	But now, behold, I am freeing you today from the chains that were on your wrists. If it pleases you to come with me to Babylon, then come, and I will take care of you. But if it seems wrong to you to come with me to Babylon, go no farther. Look, the whole land is before you. Wherever it seems good and right to you, go there.”
23040005	But before Jeremiah turned to go, Nebuzaradan added, “Return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the cities of Judah, and stay with him among the people, or go anywhere else that seems right.” Then the captain of the guard gave him a ration and a gift and released him.
23040006	So Jeremiah went to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah and stayed with him among the people who were left in the land.
23040007	When all the commanders and men of the armies in the field heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam over the land and that he had put him in charge of the men, women, and children who were the poorest of the land and had not been exiled to Babylon,
23040008	they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite—they and their men.
23040009	Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, swore an oath to them and their men, assuring them, “Do not be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.
23040010	As for me, I will stay in Mizpah to represent you before the Chaldeans who come to us. As for you, gather wine grapes, summer fruit, and oil, place them in your storage jars, and live in the cities you have taken.”
23040011	When all the Jews in Moab, Ammon, Edom, and all the other lands heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant in Judah and had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, over them,
23040012	they all returned from all the places to which they had been banished and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah. And they gathered an abundance of wine grapes and summer fruit.
23040013	Meanwhile, Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the armies in the field came to Gedaliah at Mizpah
23040014	and said to him, “Are you aware that Baalis king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah son of Ahikam did not believe them.
23040015	Then Johanan son of Kareah spoke privately to Gedaliah at Mizpah. “Let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah,” he said. “No one will know it. Why should he take your life and scatter all the people of Judah who have gathered to you, so that the remnant of Judah would perish?”
23040016	But Gedaliah son of Ahikam said to Johanan son of Kareah, “Do not do such a thing! What you are saying about Ishmael is a lie.”
23041001	In the seventh month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was a member of the royal family and one of the king’s chief officers, came with ten men to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah, and they ate a meal together there.
23041002	Then Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men who were with him got up and struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, with the sword, killing the one whom the king of Babylon had appointed to govern the land.
23041003	Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, as well as the Chaldean soldiers who were there.
23041004	On the second day after the murder of Gedaliah, when no one yet knew about it,
23041005	eighty men who had shaved off their beards, torn their garments, and cut themselves came from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria, carrying grain offerings and frankincense for the house of the LORD.
23041006	And Ishmael son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went. When Ishmael encountered the men, he said, “Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam.”
23041007	And when they came into the city, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the men with him slaughtered them and threw them into a cistern.
23041008	But ten of the men among them said to Ishmael, “Do not kill us, for we have hidden treasure in the field—wheat, barley, oil, and honey!” So he refrained from killing them with the others.
23041009	Now the cistern into which Ishmael had thrown all the bodies of the men he had struck down along with Gedaliah was a large one that King Asa had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the slain.
23041010	Then Ishmael took captive all the remnant of the people of Mizpah—the daughters of the king along with all the others who remained in Mizpah—over whom Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam. Ishmael son of Nethaniah took them captive and set off to cross over to the Ammonites.
23041011	When Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the armies with him heard of all the crimes that Ishmael son of Nethaniah had committed,
23041012	they took all their men and went to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. And they found him near the great pool in Gibeon.
23041013	When all the people with Ishmael saw Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the army with him, they rejoiced,
23041014	and all the people whom Ishmael had taken captive at Mizpah turned and went over to Johanan son of Kareah.
23041015	But Ishmael son of Nethaniah and eight of his men escaped from Johanan and went to the Ammonites.
23041016	Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the armies with him took the whole remnant of the people from Mizpah whom he had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after Ishmael had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam: the soldiers, women, children, and court officials he had brought back from Gibeon.
23041017	And they went and stayed in Geruth Chimham, near Bethlehem, in order to proceed into Egypt
23041018	to escape the Chaldeans. For they were afraid of the Chaldeans because Ishmael son of Nethaniah had struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the land.
23042001	Then all the commanders of the forces, along with Johanan son of Kareah, Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest, approached
23042002	Jeremiah the prophet and said, “May our petition come before you; pray to the LORD your God on behalf of this entire remnant. For few of us remain of the many, as you can see with your own eyes.
23042003	Pray that the LORD your God will tell us the way we should walk and the thing we should do.”
23042004	“I have heard you,” replied Jeremiah the prophet. “I will surely pray to the LORD your God as you request, and I will tell you everything that the LORD answers. I will not withhold a word from you.”
23042005	Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act upon every word that the LORD your God sends you to tell us.
23042006	Whether it is pleasant or unpleasant, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God to whom we are sending you, so that it may go well with us when we obey the voice of the LORD our God!”
23042007	After ten days the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah,
23042008	and he summoned Johanan son of Kareah, all the commanders of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least to the greatest.
23042009	Jeremiah told them, “Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition:
23042010	‘If you will indeed stay in this land, then I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you, for I will relent of the disaster I have brought upon you.
23042011	Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear; do not be afraid of him, declares the LORD, for I am with you to save you and deliver you from him.
23042012	And I will show you compassion, and he will have compassion on you and restore you to your own land.’
23042013	But if you say, ‘We will not stay in this land,’ and you thus disobey the voice of the LORD your God,

23042018	For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Just as My anger and wrath were poured out on the residents of Jerusalem, so will My wrath be poured out on you if you go to Egypt. You will become an object of cursing and horror, of vilification and disgrace, and you will never see this place again.’
23042019	The LORD has told you, O remnant of Judah, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ Know for sure that I have warned you today!
23042020	For you have deceived yourselves by sending me to the LORD your God, saying, ‘Pray to the LORD our God on our behalf, and as for all that the LORD our God says, tell it to us and we will do it.’

23043001	When Jeremiah had finished telling all the people all the words of the LORD their God—everything that the LORD had sent him to say—

23043013	He will demolish the sacred pillars of the temple of the sun in the land of Egypt, and he will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.’”

23044004	Yet I sent you all My servants the prophets again and again, saying: ‘Do not do this detestable thing that I hate.’
23044005	But they did not listen or incline their ears; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.

23044007	So now, this is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Why are you doing such great harm to yourselves by cutting off from Judah man and woman, child and infant, leaving yourselves without a remnant?
23044008	Why are you provoking Me to anger by the work of your hands by burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt, where you have gone to reside? As a result, you will be cut off and will become an object of cursing and reproach among all the nations of the earth.
23044009	Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers and of the kings of Judah and their wives, as well as the wickedness that you and your wives committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
23044010	To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed My instruction or the statutes that I set before you and your fathers.
23044011	Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I will set My face to bring disaster and to cut off all Judah.
23044012	And I will take away the remnant of Judah who have resolved to go to the land of Egypt to reside there; they will meet their end. They will all fall by the sword or be consumed by famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine; and they will become an object of cursing and horror, of vilification and reproach.
23044013	I will punish those who live in the land of Egypt, just as I punished Jerusalem, by sword and famine and plague,
23044014	so that none of the remnant of Judah who have gone to reside in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, where they long to return and live; for none will return except a few fugitives.”

At that time we had plenty of food and good things, and we saw no disaster.

23044020	Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him,
23044021	“As for the incense you burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem—you, your fathers, your kings, your officials, and the people of the land—did the LORD not remember and bring this to mind?

23044027	I am watching over them for harm and not for good, and every man of Judah who is in the land of Egypt will meet his end by sword or famine, until they are finished off.
23044028	Those who escape the sword will return from Egypt to Judah, few in number, and the whole remnant of Judah who went to dwell in the land of Egypt will know whose word will stand, Mine or theirs!

23044030	This is what the LORD says: Behold, I will deliver Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemies who seek his life, just as I delivered Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who was seeking his life.”

24003022	Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
24003023	They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
24003024	“The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
24003025	The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
24003026	It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
24003027	It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.
24003028	Let him sit alone in silence, for the LORD has laid it upon him.
24003029	Let him bury his face in the dust— perhaps there is still hope.
24003030	Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
24003031	For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
24003032	Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.
24003033	For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the sons of men.
24003034	To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,
24003035	to deny a man justice before the Most High,
24003036	to subvert a man in his lawsuit— of these the Lord does not approve.
24003037	Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
24003038	Do not both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
24003039	Why should any mortal man complain, in view of his sins?
24003040	Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
24003041	Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
24003042	“We have sinned and rebelled; You have not forgiven.”
24003043	You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have killed without pity.
24003044	You have covered Yourself with a cloud that no prayer can pass through.
24003045	You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
24003046	All our enemies open their mouths against us.
24003047	Panic and pitfall have come upon us— devastation and destruction.
24003048	Streams of tears flow from my eyes over the destruction of the daughter of my people.
24003049	My eyes overflow unceasingly, without relief,
24003050	until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
24003051	My eyes bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.
24003052	Without cause my enemies hunted me like a bird.
24003053	They dropped me alive into a pit and cast stones upon me.
24003054	The waters flowed over my head, and I thought I was going to die.
24003055	I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the depths of the Pit.
24003056	You heard my plea: “Do not ignore my cry for relief.”
24003057	You drew near when I called on You; You said, “Do not be afraid.”
24003058	You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.
24003059	You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!
24003060	You have seen all their malice, all their plots against me.
24003061	O LORD, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
24003062	the slander and murmuring of my assailants against me all day long.
24003063	When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
24003064	You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
24003065	Put a veil of anguish over their hearts; may Your curse be upon them!
24003066	You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.
24004001	How the gold has become tarnished, the pure gold has become dull! The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner.
24004002	How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in pure gold, are now esteemed as jars of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
24004003	Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like an ostrich in the wilderness.
24004004	The nursing infant’s tongue clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth. Little children beg for bread, but no one gives them any.
24004005	Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets; those brought up in crimson huddle in ash heaps.
24004006	The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her.
24004007	Her dignitaries were brighter than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like sapphires.
24004008	But now their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
24004009	Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced with pain because the fields lack produce.
24004010	The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
24004011	The LORD has exhausted His wrath; He has poured out His fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has consumed her foundations.
24004012	The kings of the earth did not believe, nor any people of the world, that an enemy or a foe could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
24004013	But this was for the sins of her prophets and the guilt of her priests, who shed the blood of the righteous in her midst.
24004014	They wandered blind in the streets, defiled by this blood, so that no one dared to touch their garments.
24004015	“Go away! Unclean!” men shouted at them. “Away, away! Do not touch us!” So they fled and wandered. Among the nations it was said, “They can stay here no longer.”
24004016	The presence of the LORD has scattered them; He regards them no more. The priests are shown no honor; the elders find no favor.
24004017	All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help. We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us.
24004018	They stalked our every step, so that we could not walk in our streets. Our end drew near, our time ran out, for our end had come!
24004019	Those who chased us were swifter than the eagles in the sky; they pursued us over the mountains and ambushed us in the wilderness.
24004020	The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits. We had said of him, “Under his shadow we will live among the nations.”
24004021	So rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz. Yet the cup will pass to you as well; you will get drunk and expose yourself.
24004022	O Daughter of Zion, your punishment is complete; He will not prolong your exile. But He will punish your iniquity, O Daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins.
24005001	Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!
24005002	Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to foreigners.
24005003	We have become fatherless orphans; our mothers are widows.
24005004	We must buy the water we drink; our wood comes at a price.
24005005	We are closely pursued; we are weary and find no rest.
24005006	We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
24005007	Our fathers sinned and are no more, but we bear their punishment.
24005008	Slaves rule over us; there is no one to deliver us from their hands.
24005009	We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the wilderness.
24005010	Our skin is as hot as an oven with fever from our hunger.
24005011	Women have been ravished in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.
24005012	Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders receive no respect.
24005013	Young men toil at millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.
24005014	The elders have left the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.
24005015	Joy has left our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
24005016	The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
24005017	Because of this, our hearts are faint; because of these, our eyes grow dim—
24005018	because of Mount Zion, which lies desolate, patrolled by foxes.
24005019	You, O LORD, reign forever; Your throne endures from generation to generation.
24005020	Why have You forgotten us forever? Why have You forsaken us for so long?
24005021	Restore us to Yourself, O LORD, so we may return; renew our days as of old,
24005022	unless You have utterly rejected us and remain angry with us beyond measure.
25001001	In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.
25001002	On the fifth day of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—
25001003	the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar. And there the LORD’s hand was upon him.
25001004	I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it. In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber,
25001005	and within it was the form of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: They had a human form,
25001006	but each had four faces and four wings.
25001007	Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.
25001008	Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings,
25001009	and their wings were touching one another. They did not turn as they moved; each one went straight ahead.
25001010	The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.
25001011	Such were their faces. Their wings were spread upward; each had two wings touching the wings of the creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.
25001012	Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.
25001013	In the midst of the living creatures was the appearance of glowing coals of fire, or of torches. Fire moved back and forth between the living creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.
25001014	The creatures were darting back and forth as quickly as flashes of lightning.
25001015	When I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.
25001016	The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. Their workmanship looked like a wheel within a wheel.
25001017	As they moved, they went in any of the four directions, without pivoting as they moved.
25001018	Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
25001019	So as the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them, and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
25001020	Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
25001021	When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stood still, the wheels stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
25001022	Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.
25001023	And under the expanse, their wings stretched out toward one another. Each one also had two wings covering its body.
25001024	When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.
25001025	And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.
25001026	Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man.
25001027	From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. And from what seemed to be His waist down, I saw what looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded Him.
25001028	The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.
25002001	“Son of man,” He said to me, “stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.”
25002002	And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me.
25002003	“Son of man,” He said to me, “I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. To this very day they and their fathers have rebelled against Me.
25002004	They are obstinate and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you are to say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
25002005	And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
25002006	But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.
25002007	But speak My words to them, whether they listen or refuse to listen, for they are rebellious.
25002008	And you, son of man, listen to what I tell you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.”

25003019	But if you warn a wicked man and he does not turn from his wickedness and his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved yourself.
25003020	Now if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I put a stumbling block before him, he will die. If you did not warn him, he will die in his sin, and the righteous acts he did will not be remembered. And I will hold you responsible for his blood.
25003021	But if you warn the righteous man not to sin, and he does not sin, he will indeed live because he heeded your warning, and you will have saved yourself.”

25004006	When you have completed these days, lie down again, but on your right side, and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have assigned to you 40 days, a day for each year.
