47004015	What then has become of your blessing? For I can testify that, if it were possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
47004016	Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
47004017	Those people are zealous for you, but not in a good way. Instead, they want to isolate you from us, so that you may be zealous for them.
47004018	Nevertheless, it is good to be zealous if it serves a noble purpose—at any time, and not only when I am with you.
47004019	My children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,
47004020	how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you.
47004021	Tell me, you who want to be under the law, do you not understand what the law says?
47004022	For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
47004023	His son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, but his son by the free woman was born through the promise.
47004024	These things serve as illustrations, for the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.
47004025	Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.
47004026	But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother.
47004027	For it is written: “Rejoice, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband.”
47004028	Now you, brothers, like Isaac, are children of promise.
47004029	At that time, however, the son born by the flesh persecuted the son born by the Spirit. It is the same now.
47004030	But what does the Scripture say? “Expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with the free woman’s son.”
47004031	Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.
47005001	It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
47005002	Take notice: I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.
47005003	Again I testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.
47005004	You who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
47005005	But by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of righteousness.
47005006	For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. What matters is faith expressing itself through love.
47005007	You were running so well. Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?
47005008	Such persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.
47005009	A little leaven works through the whole batch of dough.
47005010	I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
47005011	Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.
47005012	As for those who are agitating you, I wish they would proceed to emasculate themselves!
47005013	For you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.
47005014	The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
47005015	But if you keep on biting and devouring one another, watch out, or you will be consumed by one another.
47005016	So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
47005017	For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.
47005018	But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
47005019	The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;
47005020	idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,
47005021	and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
47005022	But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
47005023	gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
47005024	Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
47005025	Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.
47005026	Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.
47006001	Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
47006002	Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
47006003	If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
47006004	Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
47006005	For each one should carry his own load.
47006006	Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
47006007	Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
47006008	The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
47006009	Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
47006010	Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
47006011	See what large letters I am using to write to you with my own hand!
47006012	Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.
47006013	For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
47006014	But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
47006015	For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.
47006016	Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the Israel of God.
47006017	From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
47006018	The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

48001018	I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,
48001019	and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,
48001020	which He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,
48001021	far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in the present age but also in the one to come.
48001022	And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,
48001023	which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
48002001	And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,
48002002	in which you used to walk when you conformed to the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air, the spirit who is now at work in the sons of disobedience.
48002003	All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.
48002004	But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
48002005	made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!
48002006	And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
48002007	in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
48002008	For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,
48002009	not by works, so that no one can boast.
48002010	For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
48002011	Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands)—
48002012	remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.
48002013	But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.
48002014	For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility
48002015	by abolishing in His flesh the law of commandments and decrees. He did this to create in Himself one new man out of the two, thus making peace
48002016	and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross, by which He put to death their hostility.
48002017	He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
48002018	For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.
48002019	Therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household,
48002020	built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.
48002021	In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
48002022	And in Him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for God in His Spirit.
48003001	For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles...
48003002	Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,
48003003	that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.
48003004	In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
48003005	which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets.
48003006	This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.
48003007	I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.
48003008	Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
48003009	and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.
48003010	His purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
48003011	according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
48003012	In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.
48003013	So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.
48003014	... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,
48003015	from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
48003016	I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
48003017	so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
48003018	will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth
48003019	of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
48003020	Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
48003021	to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
48004001	As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:
48004002	with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
48004003	and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.
48004004	There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;
48004005	one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
48004006	one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
48004007	Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
48004008	This is why it says: “When He ascended on high, He led captives away, and gave gifts to men.”
48004009	What does “He ascended” mean, except that He also descended to the lower parts of the earth?
48004010	He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.
48004011	And it was He who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,
48004012	to equip the saints for works of ministry and to build up the body of Christ,
48004013	until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.
48004014	Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.
48004015	Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.
48004016	From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part.
48004017	So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.
48004018	They are darkened in their understanding and alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardness of their hearts.
48004019	Having lost all sense of shame, they have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity, with a craving for more.
48004020	But this is not the way you came to know Christ.
48004021	Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—
48004022	to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
48004023	to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;
48004024	and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
48004025	Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
48004026	“Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
48004027	and do not give the devil a foothold.
48004028	He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.
48004029	Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
48004030	And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
48004031	Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.
48004032	Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
48005001	Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,
48005002	and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
48005003	But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
48005004	Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.
48005005	For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
48005006	Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
48005007	Therefore do not be partakers with them.
48005008	For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
48005009	for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
48005010	Test and prove what pleases the Lord.
48005011	Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
48005012	For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
48005013	But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.
48005014	So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
48005015	Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
48005016	redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
48005017	Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
48005018	Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
48005019	Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
48005020	always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
48005021	Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
48005022	Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
48005023	For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
48005024	Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
48005025	Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
48005026	to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,
48005027	and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
48005028	In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
48005029	Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.
48005030	For we are members of His body.
48005031	“For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
48005032	This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
48005033	Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
48006001	Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
48006002	“Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),
48006003	“that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”
48006004	Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
48006005	Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.
48006006	And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
48006007	Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
48006008	because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.
48006009	And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him.
48006010	Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
48006011	Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.
48006012	For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
48006013	Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.
48006014	Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,
48006015	and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.
48006016	In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
48006017	And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
48006018	Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
48006019	Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,
48006020	for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly, as I should.
48006021	Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.
48006022	I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
48006023	Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
48006024	Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
49001001	Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
49001002	Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
49001003	I thank my God every time I remember you.
49001004	In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,
49001005	because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
49001006	being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
49001007	It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
49001008	God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
49001009	And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
49001010	so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
49001011	filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
49001012	Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.
49001013	As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
49001014	And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.
49001015	It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.
49001016	The latter do so in love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.
49001017	The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
49001018	What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
49001019	because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.
49001020	I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
49001021	For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
49001022	But if I go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. So what shall I choose? I do not know.
49001023	I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.
49001024	But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.
49001025	Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,
49001026	so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me.
49001027	Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending together as one for the faith of the gospel,
49001028	without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.
49001029	For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,
49001030	since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.
49002001	Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
49002002	then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.
49002003	Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.
49002004	Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.
49002005	Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:
49002006	Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,
49002007	but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.
49002008	And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death— even death on a cross.
49002009	Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,
49002010	that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
49002011	and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
49002012	Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.
49002013	For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
49002014	Do everything without complaining or arguing,
49002015	so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world
49002016	as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.
49002017	But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.
49002018	So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.
49002019	Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.
49002020	I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.
49002021	For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
49002022	But you know Timothy’s proven worth, that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.
49002023	So I hope to send him as soon as I see what happens with me.
49002024	And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.
49002025	But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my needs.
49002026	For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.
49002027	He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.
49002028	Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.
49002029	Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,
49002030	because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.
49003001	Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.
49003002	Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!
49003003	For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
49003004	though I myself could have such confidence. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
49003005	circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
49003006	as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.
49003007	But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.
49003008	More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
49003009	and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
49003010	I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to Him in His death,
49003011	and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead.
49003012	Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
49003013	Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,
49003014	I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
49003015	All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.
49003016	Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained.
49003017	Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.
49003018	For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
49003019	Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.
49003020	But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
49003021	who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.
49004001	Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
49004002	I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
49004003	Yes, and I ask you, my true yokefellow, to help these women who have contended at my side for the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.
49004004	Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
49004005	Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.
49004006	Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
49004007	And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
49004008	Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.
49004009	Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.
49004010	Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.
49004011	I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
49004012	I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. In any and every situation I have learned the secret of being filled and being hungry, of having plenty and having need.
49004013	I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
49004014	Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.
49004015	And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.
49004016	For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.
49004017	Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.
49004018	I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
49004019	And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
49004020	To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.

50002001	For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,
50002002	that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, namely Christ,
50002003	in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
50002004	I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric.
50002005	For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.
50002006	Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him,
50002007	rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
50002008	See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.
50002009	For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form.
50002010	And you have been made complete in Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
50002011	In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.
50002012	And having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God, who raised Him from the dead.
50002013	When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,
50002014	having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!
50002015	And having disarmed the powers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.
50002016	Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.
50002017	These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.
50002018	Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you with speculation about what he has seen. Such a person is puffed up without basis by his unspiritual mind.
50002019	He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.
50002020	If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:
50002021	“Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!”?
50002022	These will all perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.
50002023	Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.
50003001	Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
50003002	Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
50003003	For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
50003004	When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
50003005	Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
50003006	Because of these, the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
50003007	When you lived among them, you also used to walk in these ways.
50003008	But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
50003009	Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,
50003010	and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
50003011	Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
50003012	Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
50003013	Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
50003014	And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
50003015	Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
50003016	Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
50003017	And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
50003018	Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
50003019	Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
50003020	Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
50003021	Fathers, do not provoke your children, so they will not become discouraged.
50003022	Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.
50003023	Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
50003024	because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
50003025	Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.
50004001	Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
50004002	Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful,
50004003	as you pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.
50004004	Pray that I may declare it clearly, as I should.
50004005	Act wisely toward outsiders, redeeming the time.
50004006	Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.
50004007	Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.
50004008	I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
50004009	With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.
50004010	My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas. You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.
50004011	Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.
50004012	Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God.

50004018	This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
51001001	Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
51001002	We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers
51001003	and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
51001004	Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,
51001005	because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction—just as you know we lived among you for your sake.
51001006	And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.
51001007	As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
51001008	For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
51001009	For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God
51001010	and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
51002001	You yourselves know, brothers, that our visit to you was not in vain.
51002002	As you are aware, we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi. But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.
51002003	For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery.
51002004	Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
51002005	As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. God is our witness!
51002006	Nor did we seek praise from you or from anyone else, although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it.
51002007	On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.
51002008	We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.
51002009	Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
51002010	You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.
51002011	For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children—
51002012	encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
51002013	And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it truly is, the word of God, which is also now at work in you who believe.
51002014	For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,
51002015	who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,
51002016	hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved. As a result, they continue to heap up their sins to full capacity; the utmost wrath has come upon them.
51002017	Brothers, although we were torn away from you for a short time (in person, not in heart), our desire to see you face to face was even more intense.
51002018	For we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan obstructed us.
51002019	After all, who is our hope, our joy, our crown of boasting, if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?
51002020	You are indeed our glory and our joy.
51003001	So when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left on our own in Athens.
51003002	We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
51003003	so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.
51003004	Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.
51003005	For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and that our labor might have been in vain.
51003006	But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, and the fond memories you have preserved, longing to see us just as we long to see you.
51003007	For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.
51003008	For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.
51003009	How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?
51003010	Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking in your faith.
51003011	Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
51003012	And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,
51003013	so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
51004001	Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.
51004002	For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
51004003	For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;
51004004	each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,
51004005	not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;
51004006	and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.
51004007	For God has not called us to impurity, but to holiness.
51004008	Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.
51004009	Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
51004010	And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more
51004011	and to aspire to live quietly, to attend to your own matters, and to work with your own hands, as we instructed you.
51004012	Then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone.
51004013	Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
51004014	For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
51004015	By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.
51004016	For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.
51004017	After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
51004018	Therefore encourage one another with these words.
51005001	Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.
51005002	For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
51005003	While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
51005004	But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.
51005005	For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
51005006	So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.
51005007	For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
51005008	But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
51005009	For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
51005010	He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
51005011	Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
51005012	But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.
51005013	In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
51005014	And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
51005015	Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
51005016	Rejoice at all times.
51005017	Pray without ceasing.
51005018	Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
51005019	Do not extinguish the Spirit.
51005020	Do not treat prophecies with contempt,
51005021	but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.
51005022	Abstain from every form of evil.
51005023	Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
51005024	The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
51005025	Brothers, pray for us as well.
51005026	Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
51005027	I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
51005028	The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
52001001	Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
52001002	Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
52001003	We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
52001004	That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.
52001005	All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.
52001006	After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,

52001008	in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
52001009	They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,
52001010	on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.
52001011	To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,
52001012	so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
52002001	Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,
52002002	not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.
52002003	Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.
52002004	He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
52002005	Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?
52002006	And you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.
52002007	For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.
52002008	And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.
52002009	The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,
52002010	and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.
52002011	For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,
52002012	in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness.
52002013	But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.
52002014	To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
52002015	Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
52002016	Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
52002017	encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.
52003001	Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.
52003002	And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.
52003003	But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
52003004	And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.
52003005	May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
52003006	Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.
52003007	For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,

53001001	Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
53001002	To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
53001003	As I urged you on my departure to Macedonia, you should stay on at Ephesus to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines
53001004	or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.
53001005	The goal of our instruction is the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a sincere faith.
53001006	Some have strayed from these ways and turned aside to empty talk.
53001007	They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not understand what they are saying or that which they so confidently assert.
53001008	Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it legitimately.
53001009	We realize that law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers of father or mother, for murderers,
53001010	for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching
53001011	that agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed God, with which I have been entrusted.
53001012	I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, that He considered me faithful and appointed me to service.
53001013	I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.
53001014	And the grace of our Lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
53001015	This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
53001016	But for this very reason I was shown mercy, so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display His perfect patience as an example to those who would believe in Him for eternal life.
53001017	Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
53001018	Timothy, my child, I entrust you with this command in keeping with the previous prophecies about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,
53001019	holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and thereby shipwrecked their faith.
53001020	Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
53002001	First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone—
53002002	for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
53002003	This is good and pleasing in the sight of God our Savior,
53002004	who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
53002005	For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
53002006	who gave Himself as a ransom for all—the testimony that was given at just the right time.
53002007	For this reason I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a faithful and true teacher of the Gentiles. I am telling the truth; I am not lying about anything.
53002008	Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
53002009	Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
53002010	but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship God.
53002011	A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.
53002012	I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
53002013	For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.
53002014	And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression.
53002015	Women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
53003001	This is a trustworthy saying: If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.
53003002	An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of but one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
53003003	not dependent on wine, not violent but gentle, peaceable, and free of the love of money.
53003004	An overseer must manage his own household well and keep his children under control, with complete dignity.
53003005	For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how can he care for the church of God?
53003006	He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same condemnation as the devil.
53003007	Furthermore, he must have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the snare of the devil.
53003008	Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money.
53003009	They must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
53003010	Additionally, they must first be tested. Then, if they are above reproach, let them serve as deacons.
53003011	In the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.
53003012	A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
53003013	For those who have served well as deacons acquire for themselves a high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
53003014	Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these things
53003015	in case I am delayed, so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
53003016	By common confession, the mystery of godliness is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed in throughout the world, was taken up in glory.
53004001	Now the Spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith to follow deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons,
53004002	influenced by the hypocrisy of liars, whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.
53004003	They will prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods that God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
53004004	For every creation of God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,
53004005	because it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
53004006	By pointing out these things to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of faith and sound instruction that you have followed.
53004007	But reject irreverent, silly myths. Instead, train yourself for godliness.
53004008	For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
53004009	This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance.
53004010	To this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.
53004011	Command and teach these things.
53004012	Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
53004013	Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.
53004014	Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.
53004015	Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
53004016	Pay close attention to your life and to your teaching. Persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
53005001	Do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to him as to a father. Treat younger men as brothers,
53005002	older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.
53005003	Honor the widows who are truly widows.
53005004	But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
53005005	The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
53005006	But she who lives for pleasure is dead even while she is still alive.
53005007	Give these instructions to the believers, so that they will be above reproach.
53005008	If anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
53005009	A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, faithful to her husband,
53005010	and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
53005011	But refuse to enroll younger widows. For when their passions draw them away from Christ, they will want to marry,
53005012	and thus will incur judgment because they are setting aside their first faith.
53005013	At the same time they will also learn to be idle, going from house to house and being not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, discussing things they should not mention.
53005014	So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.
53005015	For some have already turned aside to follow Satan.
53005016	If any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need.
53005017	Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.
53005018	For the Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain,” and, “The worker is worthy of his wages.”
53005019	Do not entertain an accusation against an elder, except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
53005020	But those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone, so that the others will stand in fear of sin.
53005021	I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias, and to do nothing out of partiality.
53005022	Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
53005023	Stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead, because of your stomach and your frequent ailments.
53005024	The sins of some men are obvious, going ahead of them to judgment; but the sins of others do not surface until later.
53005025	In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even the ones that are inconspicuous cannot remain hidden.
53006001	All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that God’s name and our teaching will not be discredited.
53006002	Those who have believing masters should not show disrespect because they are brothers, but should serve them all the more, since those receiving their good service are beloved believers. Teach and encourage these principles.
53006003	If anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,
53006004	he is conceited and understands nothing. Instead, he has an unhealthy interest in controversies and disputes about words, out of which come envy, strife, abusive talk, evil suspicions,
53006005	and constant friction between men of depraved mind who are devoid of the truth. These men regard godliness as a means of gain.
53006006	Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
53006007	For we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it.
53006008	But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
53006009	Those who want to be rich, however, fall into temptation and become ensnared by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge them into ruin and destruction.
53006010	For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.
53006011	But you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
53006012	Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made the good confession before many witnesses.
53006013	I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:
53006014	Keep this commandment without stain or reproach until the appearance of our Lord Jesus Christ,
53006015	which the blessed and only Sovereign One—the King of kings and Lord of lords—will bring about in His own time.
53006016	He alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him, nor can anyone see Him. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.
53006017	Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.
53006018	Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, and to be generous and ready to share,
53006019	treasuring up for themselves a firm foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of that which is truly life.
53006020	O Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you. Avoid irreverent, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of so-called “knowledge,”
53006021	which some have professed and thus swerved away from the faith. Grace be with you all.
54001001	Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,
54001002	To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
54001003	I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.
54001004	Recalling your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.
54001005	I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.
54001006	For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
54001007	For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
54001008	So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.
54001009	He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
54001010	And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,
54001011	to which I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
54001012	For this reason, even though I suffer as I do, I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him for that day.
54001013	Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
54001014	Guard the treasure entrusted to you, with the help of the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
54001015	You know that everyone in the Province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
54001016	May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains.
54001017	Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently until he found me.
54001018	May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.
54002001	You therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
54002002	And the things that you have heard me say among many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well.
54002003	Join me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
54002004	A soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs, in order to please the one who enlisted him.
54002005	Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.
54002006	The hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops.
54002007	Consider what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all things.
54002008	Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, as proclaimed by my gospel,
54002009	for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained!
54002010	For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
54002011	This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with Him, we will also live with Him;
54002012	if we endure, we will also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He will also deny us;
54002013	if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself.
54002014	Remind the believers of these things, charging them before God to avoid quarreling over words, which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin.
54002015	Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
54002016	But avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which will only lead to more ungodliness,
54002017	and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
54002018	who have deviated from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already occurred, and they undermine the faith of some.
54002019	Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
54002020	A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. Some indeed are for honorable use, but others are for common use.
54002021	So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master, and prepared for every good work.
54002022	Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
54002023	But reject foolish and ignorant speculation, for you know that it breeds quarreling.
54002024	And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.
54002025	He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.
54002026	Then they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to his will.
54003001	But understand this: In the last days terrible times will come.
54003002	For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
54003003	unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, without love of good,
54003004	traitorous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
54003005	having a form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such as these!
54003006	They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,
54003007	who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
54003008	Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.
54003009	But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.
54003010	You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance,
54003011	my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
54003012	Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
54003013	while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
54003014	But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.
54003015	From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
54003016	All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
54003017	so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
54004001	I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
54004002	Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
54004003	For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
54004004	So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
54004005	But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
54004006	For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.
54004007	I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
54004008	From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.
54004009	Make every effort to come to me quickly,
54004010	because Demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
54004011	Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.
54004012	Tychicus, however, I have sent to Ephesus.
54004013	When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
54004014	Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
54004015	You too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message.
54004016	At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.
54004017	But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.
