54004018	And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
54004019	Greet Prisca and Aquila, as well as the household of Onesiphorus.
54004020	Erastus has remained at Corinth, and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus.
54004021	Make every effort to come to me before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
54004022	The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
55001001	Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
55001002	in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
55001003	In His own time He has made His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior.
55001004	To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
55001005	The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.
55001006	An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
55001007	As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach—not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.
55001008	Instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.
55001009	He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.
55001010	For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,
55001011	who must be silenced. For the sake of dishonorable gain, they undermine entire households and teach things they should not.
55001012	As one of their own prophets has said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”
55001013	This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith
55001014	and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.
55001015	To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. Indeed, both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
55001016	They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
55002001	But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.
55002002	Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.
55002003	Older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, not slanderers or addicted to much wine, but teachers of good.
55002004	In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children,
55002005	to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
55002006	In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
55002007	In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,
55002008	and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed, having nothing bad to say about us.
55002009	Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,
55002010	not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.
55002011	For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
55002012	It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
55002013	as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
55002014	He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
55002015	Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
55003001	Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,
55003002	to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.
55003003	For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures—living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.
55003004	But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,
55003005	He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
55003006	This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
55003007	so that, having been justified by His grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.
55003008	This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people.
55003009	But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.
55003010	Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,
55003011	knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned.
55003012	As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.
55003013	Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that they will have everything they need.
55003014	And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful.
55003015	All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
56001001	Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved fellow worker,
56001002	to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets at your house:
56001003	Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
56001004	I always thank my God, remembering you in my prayers,
56001005	because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.
56001006	I pray that your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in Christ.
56001007	I take great joy and encouragement in your love, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.
56001008	So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper,
56001009	I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well.
56001010	I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whose father I became while I was in chains.
56001011	Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.
56001012	I am sending back to you him who is my very heart.
56001013	I would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel.
56001014	But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.
56001015	For perhaps this is why he was separated from you for a while, so that you might have him back for good—
56001016	no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother. He is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, both in person and in the Lord.
56001017	So if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
56001018	But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
56001019	I, Paul, write this with my own hand. I will repay it—not to mention that you owe me your very self.
56001020	Yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.
56001021	Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.
56001022	In the meantime, prepare a guest room for me, because I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
56001023	Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings,
56001024	as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
56001025	The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
57001001	On many past occasions and in many different ways, God spoke to our fathers through the prophets.
57001002	But in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, and through whom He made the universe.
57001003	The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature, upholding all things by His powerful word. After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
57001004	So He became as far superior to the angels as the name He has inherited is excellent beyond theirs.
57001005	For to which of the angels did God ever say: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father”? Or again: “I will be His Father, and He will be My Son”?
57001006	And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He says: “Let all God’s angels worship Him.”
57001007	Now about the angels He says: “He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire.”
57001008	But about the Son He says: “Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
57001009	You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You above Your companions with the oil of joy.”
57001010	And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
57001011	They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment.
57001012	You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”
57001013	Yet to which of the angels did God ever say: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet”?
57001014	Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
57002001	We must pay closer attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.
57002002	For if the message spoken by angels was binding, and every transgression and disobedience received its just punishment,
57002003	how shall we escape if we neglect such a great salvation? This salvation was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard Him,
57002004	and was affirmed by God through signs, wonders, various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to His will.
57002005	For it is not to angels that He has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.
57002006	But somewhere it is testified in these words: “What is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
57002007	You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor
57002008	and placed everything under his feet.” When God subjected all things to him, He left nothing outside of his control. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to him.
57002009	But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone.
57002010	In bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting for God, for whom and through whom all things exist, to make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.
57002011	For both the One who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.
57002012	He says: “I will proclaim Your name to My brothers; I will sing Your praises in the assembly.”
57002013	And again: “I will put My trust in Him.” And once again: “Here am I, and the children God has given Me.”
57002014	Now since the children have flesh and blood, He too shared in their humanity, so that by His death He might destroy him who holds the power of death, that is, the devil,
57002015	and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
57002016	For surely it is not the angels He helps, but the descendants of Abraham.
57002017	For this reason He had to be made like His brothers in every way, so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, in order to make atonement for the sins of the people.
57002018	Because He Himself suffered when He was tempted, He is able to help those who are being tempted.
57003001	Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.
57003002	He was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.
57003003	For Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.
57003004	And every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.
57003005	Now Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house, testifying to what would be spoken later.
57003006	But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are His house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast.
57003007	Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: “Today, if you hear His voice,
57003008	do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion, in the day of testing in the wilderness,
57003009	where your fathers tested and tried Me, and for forty years saw My works.
57003010	Therefore I was angry with that generation, and I said, ‘Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known My ways.’
57003011	So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’”
57003012	See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.
57003013	But exhort one another daily, as long as it is called today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.
57003014	We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly to the end the assurance we had at first.
57003015	As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.”
57003016	For who were the ones who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?
57003017	And with whom was God angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
57003018	And to whom did He swear that they would never enter His rest? Was it not to those who disobeyed?
57003019	So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.
57004001	Therefore, while the promise of entering His rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.
57004002	For we also received the good news just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, since they did not share the faith of those who comprehended it.
57004003	Now we who have believed enter that rest. As for the others, it is just as God has said: “So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’” And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world.
57004004	For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner: “And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.”
57004005	And again, as He says in the passage above: “They shall never enter My rest.”
57004006	Since, then, it remains for some to enter His rest, and since those who formerly heard the good news did not enter because of their disobedience,
57004007	God again designated a certain day as “Today,” when a long time later He spoke through David as was just stated: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.”
57004008	For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.
57004009	There remains, then, a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
57004010	For whoever enters God’s rest also rests from his own work, just as God did from His.
57004011	Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following the same pattern of disobedience.
57004012	For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
57004013	Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
57004014	Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
57004015	For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
57004016	Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
57005001	Every high priest is appointed from among men to represent them in matters relating to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.
57005002	He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and misguided, since he himself is subject to weakness.
57005003	That is why he is obligated to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
57005004	No one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.
57005005	So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but He was called by the One who said to Him: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.”
57005006	And in another passage God says: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
57005007	During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
57005008	Although He was a Son, He learned obedience from what He suffered.
57005009	And having been made perfect, He became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey Him
57005010	and was designated by God as high priest in the order of Melchizedek.
57005011	We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.
57005012	Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!
57005013	For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.
57005014	But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.
57006001	Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith in God,
57006002	instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
57006003	And this we will do, if God permits.
57006004	It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,
57006005	who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age—
57006006	and then have fallen away—to be restored to repentance, because they themselves are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting Him to open shame.
57006007	For land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of God.
57006008	But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless, and its curse is imminent. In the end it will be burned.
57006009	Even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case—things that accompany salvation.
57006010	For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.
57006011	We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, in order to make your hope sure.
57006012	Then you will not be sluggish, but will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.
57006013	When God made His promise to Abraham, since He had no one greater to swear by, He swore by Himself,
57006014	saying, “I will surely bless you and multiply your descendants.”
57006015	And so Abraham, after waiting patiently, obtained the promise.
57006016	Men swear by someone greater than themselves, and their oath serves as a confirmation to end all argument.
57006017	So when God wanted to make the unchanging nature of His purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise, He guaranteed it with an oath.
57006018	Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
57006019	We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,
57006020	where Jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
57007001	This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
57007002	and Abraham apportioned to him a tenth of everything. First, his name means “king of righteousness.” Then also, “king of Salem” means “king of peace.”
57007003	Without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.
57007004	Consider how great Melchizedek was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.
57007005	Now the law commands the sons of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their brothers—though they too are descended from Abraham.
57007006	But Melchizedek, who did not trace his descent from Levi, collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
57007007	And indisputably, the lesser is blessed by the greater.
57007008	In the case of the Levites, mortal men collect the tenth; but in the case of Melchizedek, it is affirmed that he lives on.
57007009	And so to speak, Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham.
57007010	For when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the loin of his ancestor.
57007011	Now if perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood (for on this basis the people received the law), why was there still need for another priest to appear—one in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron?
57007012	For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed as well.
57007013	He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, from which no one has ever served at the altar.
57007014	For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, a tribe as to which Moses said nothing about priests.
57007015	And this point is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,
57007016	one who has become a priest not by a law of succession, but by the power of an indestructible life.
57007017	For it is testified: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
57007018	So the former commandment is set aside because it was weak and useless
57007019	(for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.
57007020	And none of this happened without an oath. For others became priests without an oath,
57007021	but Jesus became a priest with an oath by the One who said to Him: “The Lord has sworn and will not change His mind: ‘You are a priest forever.’”
57007022	Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
57007023	Now there have been many other priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office.
57007024	But because Jesus lives forever, He has a permanent priesthood.
57007025	Therefore He is able to save completely those who draw near to God through Him, since He always lives to intercede for them.
57007026	Such a high priest truly befits us—One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.
57007027	Unlike the other high priests, He does not need to offer daily sacrifices, first for His own sins and then for the sins of the people; He sacrificed for sin once for all when He offered up Himself.
57007028	For the law appoints as high priests men who are weak; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.
57008001	The point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,
57008002	and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.
57008003	And since every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, it was necessary for this One also to have something to offer.
57008004	Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are already priests who offer gifts according to the law.
57008005	The place where they serve is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: “See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.”
57008006	Now, however, Jesus has received a much more excellent ministry, just as the covenant He mediates is better and is founded on better promises.
57008007	For if that first covenant had been without fault, no place would have been sought for a second.
57008008	But God found fault with the people and said: “Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.
57008009	It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, because they did not abide by My covenant, and I disregarded them, declares the Lord.
57008010	For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
57008011	No longer will each one teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest.
57008012	For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”
57008013	By speaking of a new covenant, He has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and aging will soon disappear.
57009001	Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.
57009002	A tabernacle was prepared. In its first room were the lampstand, the table, and the consecrated bread. This was called the Holy Place.
57009003	Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,
57009004	containing the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. Inside the ark were the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
57009005	Above the ark were the cherubim of glory, overshadowing the mercy seat. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.
57009006	When everything had been prepared in this way, the priests entered regularly into the first room to perform their sacred duties.
57009007	But only the high priest entered the second room, and then only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.
57009008	By this arrangement the Holy Spirit was showing that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still standing.
57009009	It is an illustration for the present time, because the gifts and sacrifices being offered were unable to cleanse the conscience of the worshiper.
57009010	They consist only in food and drink and special washings—external regulations imposed until the time of reform.
57009011	But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that have come, He went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made by hands and is not a part of this creation.
57009012	He did not enter by the blood of goats and calves, but He entered the Most Holy Place once for all by His own blood, thus securing eternal redemption.
57009013	For if the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that their bodies are clean,
57009014	how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished to God, purify our consciences from works of death, so that we may serve the living God!
57009015	Therefore Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance, now that He has died to redeem them from the transgressions committed under the first covenant.
57009016	In the case of a will, it is necessary to establish the death of the one who made it,
57009017	because a will does not take effect until the one who made it has died; it cannot be executed while he is still alive.
57009018	That is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.
57009019	For when Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people,
57009020	saying, “This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep.”
57009021	In the same way, he sprinkled with blood the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship.
57009022	According to the law, in fact, nearly everything must be purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
57009023	So it was necessary for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
57009024	For Christ did not enter a man-made copy of the true sanctuary, but He entered heaven itself, now to appear on our behalf in the presence of God.
57009025	Nor did He enter heaven to offer Himself again and again, as the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.
57009026	Otherwise, Christ would have had to suffer repeatedly since the foundation of the world. But now He has appeared once for all at the end of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of Himself.
57009027	Just as man is appointed to die once, and after that to face judgment,
57009028	so also Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many; and He will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him.
57010001	For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come, not the realities themselves. It can never, by the same sacrifices offered year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.
57010002	If it could, would not the offerings have ceased? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt the guilt of their sins.
57010003	Instead, those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins,
57010004	because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
57010005	Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.
57010006	In burnt offerings and sin offerings You took no delight.
57010007	Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’”
57010008	In the passage above He says, “Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not desire, nor did You delight in them” (although they are offered according to the law).
57010009	Then He adds, “Here I am, I have come to do Your will.” He takes away the first to establish the second.
57010010	And by that will, we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
57010011	Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
57010012	But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, He sat down at the right hand of God.
57010013	Since that time, He waits for His enemies to be made a footstool for His feet,
57010014	because by a single offering He has made perfect for all time those who are being sanctified.
57010015	The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First He says:
57010016	“This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
57010017	Then He adds: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”
57010018	And where these have been forgiven, an offering for sin is no longer needed.
57010019	Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,
57010020	by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,
57010021	and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
57010022	let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
57010023	Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.
57010024	And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.
57010025	Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
57010026	If we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no further sacrifice for sins remains,
57010027	but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume all adversaries.
57010028	Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
57010029	How much more severely do you think one deserves to be punished who has trampled on the Son of God, profaned the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and insulted the Spirit of grace?
57010030	For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
57010031	It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
57010032	Remember the early days that you were in the light. In those days, you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering.
57010033	Sometimes you were publicly exposed to ridicule and persecution; at other times you were partners with those who were so treated.
57010034	You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession.
57010035	So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
57010036	You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
57010037	For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.
57010038	But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”
57010039	But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.
57011001	Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.
57011002	This is why the ancients were commended.
57011003	By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.
57011004	By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.
57011005	By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.
57011006	And without faith it is impossible to please God. For anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
57011007	By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family. By faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.
57011008	By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.
57011009	By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.
57011010	For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
57011011	By faith Sarah, even though she was barren and beyond the proper age, was enabled to conceive a child, because she considered Him faithful who had promised.
57011012	And so from one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.
57011013	All these people died in faith, without having received the things they were promised. However, they saw them and welcomed them from afar. And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.
57011014	Now those who say such things show that they are seeking a country of their own.
57011015	If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.
57011016	Instead, they were longing for a better country, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.
57011017	By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac on the altar. He who had received the promises was ready to offer his one and only son,
57011018	even though God had said to him, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
57011019	Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead, and in a sense, he did receive Isaac back from death.
57011020	By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the future.
57011021	By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
57011022	By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones.
57011023	By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were unafraid of the king’s edict.
57011024	By faith Moses, when he was grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.
57011025	He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.
57011026	He valued disgrace for Christ above the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his reward.
57011027	By faith Moses left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw Him who is invisible.
57011028	By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.
57011029	By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were drowned.
57011030	By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.
57011031	By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish with those who were disobedient.
57011032	And what more shall I say? Time will not allow me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets,
57011033	who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,
57011034	quenched the raging fire, and escaped the edge of the sword; who gained strength from weakness, became mighty in battle, and put foreign armies to flight.
57011035	Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection.
57011036	Still others endured mocking and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.
57011037	They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were put to death by the sword. They went around in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, oppressed, and mistreated.
57011038	The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and hid in caves and holes in the ground.
57011039	These were all commended for their faith, yet they did not receive what was promised.
57011040	God had planned something better for us, so that together with us they would be made perfect.
57012001	Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
57012002	Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
57012003	Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
57012004	In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
57012005	And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
57012006	For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”
57012007	Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?
57012008	If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.
57012009	Furthermore, we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them. Should we not much more submit to the Father of our spirits and live?
57012010	Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.
57012011	No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.
57012012	Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.
57012013	Make straight paths for your feet, so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.
57012014	Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.
57012015	See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God, and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.
57012016	See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.
57012017	For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears.
57012018	For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom, and storm;
57012019	to a trumpet blast or to a voice that made its hearers beg that no further word be spoken.
57012020	For they could not bear what was commanded: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned.”
57012021	The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”
57012022	Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to myriads of angels
57012023	in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven. You have come to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
57012024	to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
57012025	See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?
57012026	At that time His voice shook the earth, but now He has promised, “Once more I will shake not only the earth, but heaven as well.”
57012027	The words “Once more” signify the removal of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that the unshakable may remain.
57012028	Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.
57012029	“For our God is a consuming fire.”
57013001	Continue in brotherly love.
57013002	Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.
57013003	Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.
57013004	Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
57013005	Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”
57013006	So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
57013007	Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
57013008	Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
57013009	Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.
57013010	We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.
57013011	Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.
57013012	And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.
57013013	Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.
57013014	For here we do not have a permanent city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.
57013015	Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
57013016	And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
57013017	Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch over your souls as those who must give an account. To this end, allow them to lead with joy and not with grief, for that would be of no advantage to you.
57013018	Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.
57013019	And I especially urge you to pray that I may be restored to you soon.
57013020	Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
57013021	equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
57013022	I urge you, brothers, to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have only written to you briefly.
57013023	Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.
57013024	Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy send you greetings.
57013025	Grace be with all of you.
58001001	James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings.
58001002	Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
58001003	because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.
58001004	Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
58001005	Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
58001006	But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
58001007	That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
58001008	He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
58001009	The brother in humble circumstances should exult in his high position.
58001010	But the one who is rich should exult in his low position, because he will pass away like a flower of the field.
58001011	For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its flower falls and its beauty is lost. So too, the rich man will fade away in the midst of his pursuits.
58001012	Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
58001013	When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.
58001014	But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.
58001015	Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
58001016	Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.
58001017	Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
58001018	He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation.
58001019	My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
58001020	for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
58001021	Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
58001022	Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
58001023	For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
58001024	and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.
58001025	But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.
58001026	If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.
58001027	Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
58002001	My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.
58002002	Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in.
58002003	If you lavish attention on the man in fine clothes and say, “Here is a seat of honor,” but say to the poor man, “You must stand” or “Sit at my feet,”
58002004	have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
58002005	Listen, my beloved brothers: Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him?
58002006	But you have dishonored the poor. Is it not the rich who oppress you and drag you into court?
58002007	Are they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you have been called?
58002008	If you really fulfill the royal law stated in Scripture, “Love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing well.
58002009	But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
58002010	Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
58002011	For He who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not murder.” If you do not commit adultery, but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.
58002012	Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom.
58002013	For judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
58002014	What good is it, my brothers, if someone claims to have faith, but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?
58002015	Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.
58002016	If one of you tells him, “Go in peace; stay warm and well fed,” but does not provide for his physical needs, what good is that?
58002017	So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.
58002018	But someone will say, “You have faith and I have deeds.” Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.
58002019	You believe that God is one. Good for you! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.
58002020	O foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless?
58002021	Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
58002022	You see that his faith was working with his actions, and his faith was perfected by what he did.
58002023	And the Scripture was fulfilled that says, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness,” and he was called a friend of God.
58002024	As you can see, a man is justified by his deeds and not by faith alone.
58002025	In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route?
58002026	As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.
58003001	Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.
58003002	We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
58003003	When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can guide the whole animal.
58003004	Consider ships as well. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot is inclined.
58003005	In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
58003006	The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
58003007	All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,
58003008	but no man can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
58003009	With the tongue we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God’s likeness.
58003010	Out of the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, this should not be!
58003011	Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?
58003012	My brothers, can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.
58003013	Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
58003014	But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.
58003015	Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
58003016	For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every evil practice.
58003017	But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
58003018	Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
58004001	What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?
58004002	You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
58004003	And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
58004004	You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
58004005	Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?
58004006	But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
58004007	Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
58004008	Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
58004009	Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
58004010	Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
58004011	Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
58004012	There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
58004013	Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business, and make a profit.”
58004014	You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
58004015	Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.”
58004016	As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.
58004017	Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
58005001	Come now, you who are rich, weep and wail over the misery to come upon you.
58005002	Your riches have rotted and moths have eaten your clothes.
58005003	Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire. You have hoarded treasure in the last days.
58005004	Look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
58005005	You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened your hearts in the day of slaughter.
58005006	You have condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist you.
58005007	Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
58005008	You, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the Lord’s coming is near.
58005009	Do not complain about one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged. Look, the Judge is standing at the door!
58005010	Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
58005011	See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
58005012	Above all, my brothers, do not swear, not by heaven or earth or by any other oath. Simply let your “Yes” be yes, and your “No,” no, so that you will not fall under judgment.
58005013	Is any one of you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.
58005014	Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord.
58005015	And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.
58005016	Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.
58005017	Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.
58005018	Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth yielded its crops.
58005019	My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
58005020	consider this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
59001001	Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen
59001002	according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
59001003	Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
59001004	and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
59001005	who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
59001006	In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
59001007	so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
59001008	Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
59001009	now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
59001010	Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,
59001011	trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
59001012	It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.
59001013	Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
59001014	As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
59001015	But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,
59001016	for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”
59001017	Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.
59001018	For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
59001019	but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
59001020	He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.
59001021	Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God.
59001022	Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.
59001023	For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.
59001024	For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
59001025	but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
59002001	Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
59002002	Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
59002003	now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.
59002004	As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,
59002005	you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
59002006	For it stands in Scripture: “See, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
59002007	To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
59002008	and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.
59002009	But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
59002010	Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
59002011	Beloved, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against your soul.
59002012	Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us.
59002013	Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,
59002014	or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.
59002015	For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
59002016	Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.
59002017	Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.
59002018	Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.
59002019	For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God, this is to be commended.
59002020	How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.
59002021	For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in His footsteps:
59002022	“He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in His mouth.”
59002023	When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.
59002024	He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. “By His stripes you are healed.”
59002025	For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
59003001	Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives
59003002	when they see your pure and reverent demeanor.
59003003	Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
59003004	but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.
59003005	For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,
59003006	just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.
59003007	Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
59003008	Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.
59003009	Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
59003010	For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
59003011	He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
59003012	For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
59003013	Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good?
59003014	But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
59003015	But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
59003016	keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ.
59003017	For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
59003018	For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit,
59003019	in whom He also went and preached to the spirits in prison
59003020	who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.
59003021	And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
59003022	who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.
59004001	Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
59004002	Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.
59004003	For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
59004004	Because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.
59004005	But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
59004006	That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
59004007	The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
59004008	Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
59004009	Show hospitality to one another without complaining.
59004010	As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
59004011	If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
59004012	Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
59004013	But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
59004014	If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
59004015	Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
59004016	But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
59004017	For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?
59004018	And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
59004019	So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
59005001	As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
59005002	Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but willingly, as God would have you; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;
59005003	not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
59005004	And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.
59005005	Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
59005006	Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
59005007	Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
59005008	Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
59005009	Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
59005010	And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
59005011	To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.
59005012	Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
59005013	The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
59005014	Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
60001001	Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
60001002	Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
60001003	His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
60001004	Through these He has given us His precious and magnificent promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, now that you have escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.
60001005	For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;
60001006	and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;
60001007	and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.
60001008	For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
60001009	But whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness, having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.
60001010	Therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure. For if you practice these things you will never stumble,
60001011	and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
60001012	Therefore I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are established in the truth you now have.
60001013	I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of my body,
60001014	because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
60001015	And I will make every effort to ensure that after my departure, you will be able to recall these things at all times.
60001016	For we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
60001017	For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
60001018	And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
60001019	We also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt. And you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
60001020	Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture comes from one’s own interpretation.
60001021	For no such prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man, but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.
60002001	Now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.
60002002	Many will follow in their depravity, and because of them the way of truth will be defamed.
60002003	In their greed, these false teachers will exploit you with deceptive words. The longstanding verdict against them remains in force, and their destruction does not sleep.
60002004	For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
60002005	if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;
60002006	if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;
60002007	and if He rescued Lot, a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless
60002008	(for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—
60002009	if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
60002010	Such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and self-willed, they are unafraid to slander glorious beings.
60002011	Yet not even angels, though greater in strength and power, dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the Lord.
60002012	These men are like irrational animals, creatures of instinct, born to be captured and destroyed. They blaspheme in matters they do not understand, and like such creatures, they too will be destroyed.
60002013	The harm they will suffer is the wages of their wickedness. They consider it a pleasure to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deception as they feast with you.
60002014	Their eyes are full of adultery; their desire for sin is never satisfied; they seduce the unstable. They are accursed children with hearts trained in greed.
60002015	They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the wages of wickedness.
60002016	But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
60002017	These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.
60002018	With lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who are just escaping from others who live in error.
60002019	They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves to depravity. For a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.
60002020	If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
60002021	It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than to have known it and then to turn away from the holy commandment passed on to them.
60002022	Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”
60003001	Beloved, this is now my second letter to you. Both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking
60003002	by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.
60003003	Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.
60003004	“Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”
60003005	But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
60003006	through which the world of that time perished in the flood.
60003007	And by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
60003008	Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
60003009	The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
60003010	But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and its works will be laid bare.
60003011	Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness
60003012	as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.
60003013	But in keeping with God’s promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.
